claim: I’ve learned what 40% chance of rain means : r/apple - Reddit
summary: I don’t get how they are so different. Surely Apple gets the same raw data from the government. For my area Apple says 60% chance of rain today, 0% tomorrow, 90% the next day. Met says 100% today (it’s currently raining), 75% tomorrow, 25% the next day. Those are wildly different values.
